index_and_alignment.reference_group_equivalence: uppercase full sequence equals another member or its reverse complement
index_and_alignment.fasta_record_id: first whitespace-delimited header token, UTF-8 and unique within the file
index_and_alignment.sequence_normalization: remove ASCII whitespace between FASTA headers, then uppercase
index_and_alignment.invalid_sequence_symbol: reject the reference file without dropping or replacing the symbol
index_and_alignment.alignment_acceptance: all emitted chains with CIGAR and positive query length
